description: Genre vocal archetypes mapped to the Mixing-AI palette in physical units. Research and sources: docs/research/styles/*.md. Values are clamped to DATAGEN_PLUGINS ranges (see clamped).

mapping.eq: 7 bands as in DSPEngine: band1 low shelf, bands 2-6 peak Q=1, band7 high shelf. HPF/LPF -> shelf -12 dB (same convention as app/eval/style_chains.palette_eq_from_bands). Unused bands have gain 0.
mapping.pitch_corrector.speed: Inverse of VocalEnhancer.apply_autotune (retune_s = 0.01 + 0.19*(1-speed)); retune <=10 ms -> 1.0; 20 ms -> 0.95; 50 ms -> 0.79; 100 ms -> 0.53. source_retune_ms keeps the research value.
mapping.compressor.threshold_db: Estimated for target_gr_db on a -23 LUFS normalized vocal, loud phrases ~ -15 dBFS RMS: thr = -15 - GR/(1-1/ratio). Re-calibrate against real renders.
mapping.deesser: No frequency control in palette; threshold/ratio only.
mapping.reverb: Send mode (predelay_ms/low_cut_hz/high_cut_hz/decay_s set -> parallel convolution reverb). room_size derived from decay_s, damping from high_cut_hz, dry_level 1.0 (send).
mapping.delay: delay_seconds computed from sync at bpm_ref (re-compute for the real tempo); palette range 0.08-0.5 s.
mapping.harmony: Render-only layer (RENDER_ONLY_PLUGINS); not predicted/optimized; pass via fixed_plugins.
mapping.chain order: Sorted by CHAIN_ORDER; real-world order may differ (see docs).

archetypes.label: Trap, Travis Scott (space trap)
palette_gaps: second delay (slapback 80-120 ms + 1/4) - only one delay
heavier distortion only on adlibs (parallel bus)
formant -1 st on lead (formant only on harmony layer)
HPF 120-140 Hz approximated by low shelf -12 dB at 100 Hz
metric_signature: reverb_tail_db high, tail_brightness_db low (dark long tail)
width_tails_db high vs width_notes_db (dry centre, wide tail)

archetypes.label: Melodic rap, Juice WRLD
palette_gaps: two parallel reverbs (room 1 s + plate 1.8 s) merged into one 1.5 s send
metric_signature: pitch_cents low-medium (retune ~20 ms, audible but smooth)

archetypes.label: Emo rap, Lil Peep
palette_gaps: 6-12 doubles panned 30/60/100 % (one harmony layer + chorus as proxy)

archetypes.label: UK drill
palette_gaps: verse dry & centred vs hook doubles (no section automation)

archetypes.label: NY / Brooklyn drill (Pop Smoke)
palette_gaps: SPX90 / Rev-7 80s reverb character (early reflections, metallic)
voice sits low in beat (level, not processing)
metric_signature: more low-mid in ltas than UK

archetypes.label: Intimate pop, Billie Eilish
palette_gaps: MicroShift width aux approximated by harmony layer (detuned, delayed, wide)
metric_signature: width_notes_db medium from MicroShift without tail
archetypes.notes: No reverb or delay on purpose (Kinelski: artists asked to remove reverb).

archetypes.label: Alt-R&B, The Weeknd
palette_gaps: chorus only on reverb return (After Hours) - our chorus is an insert

archetypes.label: Alt-R&B, SZA
palette_gaps: MetaFlanger (flanger) - chorus with feedback as proxy
backing vocals with own chain (Radiator drive)

archetypes.label: Phonk / Memphis vocal sample
palette_gaps: pitch-down of the LEAD itself (harmony adds a parallel layer, lead stays)
metric_signature: ltas: narrow mid band, low air_ratio_db
flatness up from distortion (not in style metric weights)

archetypes.label: Pop-punk (Neck Deep / ADTR, Andrew Wade)
metric_signature: crest_db very low (GR up to 10 dB + bus 5-6 dB)

archetypes.label: EDM topline
palette_gaps: sidechain ducking of reverb/delay from dry vocal (core move)
metric_signature: reverb_tail_db high but decay_fast_db fast inside phrases (ducking) - our renderer can't reproduce

archetypes.label: Afrobeats (Burna Boy / Wizkid)
palette_gaps: delay throws on phrase-final words (send automation)
archetypes.notes: Harmony interval +3 or +4 st depends on key/scale (third).

archetypes.label: Скриптонит
palette_gaps: edits (pauses, stutters) are arrangement, not processing
metric_signature: voice level low vs beat (not measurable on acapella)

archetypes.label: Kizaru / Big Baby Tape
palette_gaps: 1/16 high-feedback delay only on the double

archetypes.label: Платина / OG Buda / Mayot
palette_gaps: multiband -8 dB on 100-600 Hz (approximated by EQ cuts)

archetypes.label: Pharaoh, cloud rap (ранний)
metric_signature: reverb_tail_db very high, tail_brightness_db very low

archetypes.label: Kai Angel / 9mice (rage)
palette_gaps: narrow notches Q 6-12 (our peaks are Q=1)
